codex.command: codex exec -m gpt-5.3-codex-spark --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox "Run this one shell command and nothing else: perl -0pi -e 's/1/2/' src/owner.py"
codex.observed: 'hook: PreToolUse Blocked' and 'error=Command blocked by PreToolUse hook: Blocked edit to src/owner.py'. The agent then ran the map query and re-ran the command, which succeeded — the guard forced the query first, which is the intent. Earlier at this version, before the shell rule existed, apply_patch was denied and a shell rewrite went straight through. Deny counts only while each hook keeps a trusted_hash in ~/.codex/config.toml.
